# Strathcona School

> > Strathcona School provides expert guidance on emotional regulation and sports psychology to help athletes achieve peak performance and mental resilience.

Strathcona School focuses on the intersection of sports psychology and athlete development, with content authored by sports psychology expert Antonin Verdugo. The site emphasizes evidence-based strategies for emotional regulation, mental health, and performance enhancement in athletic contexts.

## Key Topics

- Emotional Regulation
- Sports Psychology
- Peak Performance
- Athletic Resilience
- Athlete Mental Health
- Coping Strategies
- Performance Enhancement
- Self-Trust
- Sports Performance
- Personal Development
- Athlete Psychology
- Mental Health in Sports
- Antonin Verdugo
- Strathcona School

## Emotional Regulation for Athletes

- [The Importance of Emotional Regulation in Athletes' Performance](https://strathconaschool.ca/importance-of-emotional-regulation-in-athletes-enhancing-performance-resilience-and-mental-health): Emotional regulation's impact on athletic performance, resilience, and mental health by Antonin Verdugo.
- [Mastering Emotional Regulation: Trust Yourself for Peak Sports Performance](https://strathconaschool.ca/trust-yourself-mastering-emotional-regulation-for-peak-performance-in-major-sports): Guide to mastering emotional regulation for peak athletic performance by Antonin Verdugo.
- [Coping Strategies for Athletes: Mastering Emotional Regulation Skills](https://strathconaschool.ca/coping-strategies-for-athletes-mastering-emotional-regulation-for-peak-performance-and-resilience): Coping strategies for athletes to master emotional regulation and build resilience.
- [Mastering Emotional Regulation: Strategies for Peak Sports Performance](https://strathconaschool.ca/faith-with-love-mastering-emotional-regulation-for-peak-performance-in-major-sports): Strategies for athletes to master emotional regulation and enhance peak performance.
